description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.4.0. It includes methods to set up new database tables, insert configuration values, update language strings, and add OAuth2 support, as well as assign permissions related to attendance, time sheets, and employee work shifts.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Database migration class for version 5.4.0 of OrangeHRM, performs schema updates, configuration setup, language string updates, and OAuth2 table creation.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Main method executing the migration steps for database and configuration updates for version 5.4.0.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the migration, '5.4.0'.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to match the specified version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of LangStringHelper for language string management.

methods.name: modifyDefaultRequiredPasswordStrength
methods.description: Adjusts the default required password strength configuration based on existing settings.

methods.name: modifyDefaultPasswordEnforcement
methods.description: Sets the password enforcement configuration based on existing values.

methods.name: createOAuth2Tables
methods.description: Creates OAuth2 related tables and inserts default OAuth2 client, along with setting encryption keys and token TTL configuration values.

methods.name: changePermissionForAttendanceConfigurationAPI
methods.description: Adds permissions for attendance configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForTimeConfigPeriodAPI
methods.description: Adds permissions for time sheet configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForEmployeeWorkShiftAPI
methods.description: Adds permissions for employee work shift API data group.
